notes: These artifacts are byte-exact copies of canonical machine-local report files that scripts/audit_universal_sota_status.py reads from gitignored reports/ paths.
They were copied from the original working tree where the recorded runs executed; no measurement was rerun and no held-out test data was read to produce this record.
The transport objective literal_achieved status was originally recorded by the official hydration and guarded test sequence around commit 4d939f1 (worklog 2026-05-22).
The inferred transfer scorecard was originally produced by scripts/run_inferred_transport_transfer_scorecard.py at commit dad9aea (worklog 2026-05-24) on train/validation splits only.

The light-v1 demo scorecard carries the persistence_light_v1_test baseline row used by the audit improvement gate; the same baseline value is independently recorded in docs/claim_evidence/universal_sota_claim_evidence.json claim_documentation.
The audit prefers live reports/ files when present and falls back to these durable artifacts only when the live files are missing, so a clean checkout audits identically to the original working tree.
